t-flow.text: Roles · login · the three homes that are not on the floor

s-login.text: Staff login. Email + password or mobile OTP. Office roles (Admin, Ops head, QC, Assembly, Sales head) only from an allowed IP; Support and Sales field from anywhere. Lands on the home of the user's role.

s-hadmin.text: Admin / Ops head home: the whole floor in one strip (stage counts in stage colours), approvals waiting, alerts, tenants needing attention. Full sidebar.

s-hsales.text: Sales home: my tenants, open label-roll and device requests, allocations this month. Sales never touches devices on the floor.

s-side.text: One sidebar, role prop decides what shows. Operators get stage tiles, not a menu.

t-floor1.text: Operator homes — one tile per job, stage colour, big targets

s-hasm.text: Assembly operator: three tiles only — Receive (grey), Fit SIM (blue), Pack & dispatch (green) — each with its queue count. Scan button always top-right. Nothing else in the menu.

s-hqc.text: QC operator: one tile — the QC bench queue (amber) — plus faults (red). Phone scan opens the checklist for the device on the bench.

s-hsup.text: Support: alerts, tenant users (OTP resend, unlock), label replacement requests, approvals it raised. No stock actions.

t-floor2.text: Devices in — stage 1 grey · stage 2 amber · stage 3 blue

s-recv.text: Stage 1 · RECEIVED (grey). Supplier + PO + model + serial/IMEI list (paste or CSV). Creates devices inactive · no TRK ID yet. Short count vs invoice is shown, partial receive allowed.

s-qc.text: Stage 2 · QC (amber). Bench queue, checklist per model, firmware flash, pass → TRK ID is minted; fail → red, goes to Returns. Each check is a tap, not a form.

s-sim.text: Stage 3 · SIM BOUND (blue). Scan device, scan SIM barcode, first heartbeat confirms. Device is now 'ready · in stock'. M2M SIM pool shown.

t-floor3.text: Stock · device page · stage 4 green = labelled and allocated

s-inv.text: Inventory: one row per device, stage pill in stage colour, filters are the stage chips. Counts by model × stage at the top.

s-dev.text: Device page: lifecycle timeline in stage colours, identity (serial, IMEI, SIM, TRK), QR label state, tenant, last heartbeat, events. Staff actions: reprint (approval), recall, mark faulty.

s-qr.text: Stage 4 · LABELLED = ALLOCATED (green). One flow: tenant → device type + qty → print device QRs (that is the allocation) → passport QR qty + size → print here or tenant prints. No sale type, no cartons here.

s-disp.text: Stage 5 · DISPATCHED. Pack allocated devices into cartons (phone scan), delivery note, courier AWB. Tenant sees 'sent · GRN pending' by category until its ops does the GRN.

s-sup.text: Suppliers: factory / in-house assembly, contact, warranty months (12/24/36), models supplied. Picked on Receive.

s-ret.text: Faulty & returned (red): QC fails, field returns, recalls. Repair → back to QC queue; scrap → wiped, label voided. Phase-2 label replacement lives here.

t-ten1.text: Tenants — created here, portal type decided here

s-ten.text: Tenant list with vertical · type, portal type, hosted on, users, devices by category, status. Amber row = created but no admin yet.

s-tcreate.text: Company → vertical → customer type → PORTAL TYPE (pharmacy chain / distributor / device only / lab device-only / full lab / cash-van / lockbox) → devices in use → defaults. Buttons fill the Apollo, Axis, Lab cases.

s-tdet.text: Tenant page: amber banner until the first admin exists. Setup shows portal type, devices in use, login methods, branding, data-push. Tabs: devices, passports, users, settings.

s-tusers.text: Tenant users: staff ADMIN / Support may add, resend OTP, unlock; roles come from the tenant's templates. Seat count vs limit.

s-alloc.text: Allocations record: what QR labels wrote. Allocate by specific TRK IDs here when needed. De-allocate needs a reason.

s-pass.text: Passport QRs: books per tenant, who printed, label sizes; label-roll orders from tenant portals land here as an order to fulfil (print here + courier) or confirm (tenant prints).

s-prof.text: Temperature profiles are product-wise and dynamic (2–8, −20, ambient…). A tenant gets a default; the pharmacy chain picks per product at bind.

s-jour.text: Journey templates per portal type: DC→store→customer, depot→pharmacy, home→lab, lab→lab, duty/run, custody. Chains are dynamic; carton legs inherited.

s-trips.text: Trips / duties across tenants: open legs, by portal type (pharmacy journeys, cash-van duties, lockbox pickups). Read-only for staff except exceptions.

s-alerts.text: Alerts: excursion, silent device, low battery, Lite not returned, tamper. Colour = severity word. Assign to Support, close with a note.

s-appr.text: Two-person rule: tenant create/change, contract change, allocation above 50, passport batch above 10,000, label reprint, BFSI actions. Maker sees pending, checker approves with a reason.

s-staff.text: Staff users: 8 roles (Admin, Ops head, Ops–Assembly, Ops–QC, Ops–Support, Sales head, Sales scoped head, Sales field); IP-required flag per role; who may create whom.

s-rep.text: Reports: stock by stage, devices per tenant, passports issued/used, SLA of the floor (days from receive to dispatch), alerts per tenant. Excel / CSV / PDF.

s-audit.text: Audit log: every write, including PRINT of a label and every approval, with who/when/reason. Filter by tenant, device, user.

s-ref.text: Reference data: device types (HUB, Pro, Lite, Lockbox, Tracker), verticals, customer types, portal types, label sizes, SIM providers, warranty terms, approval thresholds.

t-phone.text: Phone scan screens — the operator's phone on the floor (390 wide)

s-plog.text: Mobile OTP login. Role decides the home.

s-phome.text: Big Scan button; the three stage tiles with counts.

s-pscan.text: Camera. Device QR, SIM barcode, or carton QR — the app knows which.

s-pqc.text: Checklist per model, one tap per check. Pass mints the TRK ID.

s-psim.text: Scan device → scan SIM → wait for heartbeat → bound (blue).

s-plabel.text: After printing: scan the sticker; it must open this page = pass.

s-ppack.text: Scan devices into a carton for the tenant; count matches the delivery note.

s-tdev.text: Tenant-wise view of every device's functionality (heartbeat, battery, temp sensor, GPS, lid/bag, SIM) with colour + word per cell. Working / Attention / Fallen out / Returning. Click a device → manage the fall-out: call site, raise to tenant admin, send a swap (= allocate from stock), recall, snooze, close. Every action = audit row + shows on the tenant's alert.
